Nigella Sativa (Black Seed)

GHS 110

In Stock (10 available)

Our Nigella Sativa — known locally as 'chimen' and revered across the Islamic and traditional African medical traditions — is sourced from partner farms in northern Ghana. These tiny black seeds contain thymoquinone, a compound with remarkable antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating properties.

Supports robust immune system function
Promotes respiratory and lung health
Supports healthy blood sugar regulation

Supports healthy skin and hair growth
